name: firecrawl
description: Scrape, crawl, map, and extract structured data from any website with Firecrawl.

interface.shortDescription: Turn any website into clean markdown or structured data for agents.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to Firecrawl's official MCP server (mcp.firecrawl.dev) for agent-grade web data. Scrape single pages into clean markdown, map entire sites, run multi-page crawls, search the web with optional scraping, and extract schema-shaped JSON with LLM extraction. Works keyless on a rate-limited free tier; add a Firecrawl API key for full quotas. Skills cover the v2 API, key setup, and crawl etiquette with cost control.
defaultPrompt: Scrape {url} and summarize it as clean markdown
Map {site} and list every page under /docs
Extract name, price, and features from these product pages into JSON
